messages.subject: Axivity, CSV conversion to CWA.
parts:
Earlier last year I exported my raw data from the axivity in CSV format to use in GGIR. Unfortunately I am having issues in using this raw format again in GGIR. I only have the raw data in CSV and I am wondering if a) there is a way to convert this to a CWA file and b) would this make a difference? I am keen to use this data in another study but fear it won't run correctly, any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks in advance.
